            '  // VS-15 M6.2: layer visibility and grouping derive from the ONE durable\r\n'
            '  // MapsPreferences provider (device-scoped). The old independent local\r\n'
            '  // booleans are retired — a recreated surface cannot reset a user choice.\r\n'
            '  bool get _showPeople => ref.read(mapsPreferencesProvider).showContacts;\r\n'
            '  bool get _showEvents => ref.read(mapsPreferencesProvider).showEvents;\r\n'
            '  bool get _showPlaces => ref.read(mapsPreferencesProvider).showSavedPlaces;\r\n'
            '  bool get _groupNearby => ref.read(mapsPreferencesProvider).groupNearbyMarkers;\r\n'
            '  bool _lastGroupingMode = true;\r\n'
            '  int _cameraIntent = 0;\r\n'
            '  bool _appliedPassiveCoordinate = false;\r\n'
            '  final GlobalKey _mapTypeAnchorKey = GlobalKey();\r\n'
            '  static final Map<String, BitmapDescriptor> _markerIcons =\r\n'
            '      <String, BitmapDescriptor>{};\r\n'
            '  static final Map<String, Future<BitmapDescriptor>> _loadingMarkerIcons = {};\r\n'
            '  static final Map<int, BitmapDescriptor> _aggregateIcons = {};\r\n'
            '  static final Map<int, BitmapDescriptor> _selectedAggregateIcons = {};\r\n'
            '  final Set<int> _loadingSelectedAggregates = {};\r\n'
            '  static final Map<String, BitmapDescriptor> _separatedRemainderIcons = {};\r\n'
            '  final Set<String> _loadingSeparatedRemainders = {};\r\n'
            '  static final Map<int, Future<BitmapDescriptor>> _loadingAggregateIcons = {};\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  @override\r\n'
            '  void initState() {\r\n'
            '    super.initState();\r\n'
            '    final session = ref.read(mapsSessionProvider);\r\n'
            '    final initial = widget.initialCoordinate;\r\n'
            '    _initialCameraPosition =\r\n'
            '        session.camera ??\r\n'
            '        CameraPosition(\r\n'
            '          target: LatLng(initial?.latitude ?? 20, initial?.longitude ?? 0),\r\n'
            '          zoom: initial == null ? 1.4 : 16,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '    _lastCameraPosition = _initialCameraPosition;\r\n'
            '    _startupCameraClaimed = session.camera != null;\r\n'
            '    _appliedPassiveCoordinate = session.camera != null || initial != null;\r\n'
            '    _showMyLocation = initial != null;\r\n'
            '    ref.listenManual(mapTransientFocusProvider, (_, focusState) {\r\n'
            '      final request = focusState.pending;\r\n'
            '      if (request != null) {\r\n'
            '        unawaited(_handleFocus(request));\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '    unawaited(_primeMarkerIcons());\r\n'
            '    ref.listenManual(mapSelectedMarkerProvider, (_, selection) {\r\n'
            '      _cameraIntent += 1; // A late navigation result cannot replace a new tap.\r\n'
            '      _selectionGeneration += 1;\r\n'
            '      unawaited(_syncNativeSelection(selection, _selectionGeneration));\r\n'
            '      unawaited(_primeSelectedIcon(selection));\r\n'
            '      if (mounted) setState(() {});\r\n'

            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  @override\r\n'
            '  void didUpdateWidget(covariant GoogleMapsSurface oldWidget) {\r\n'
            '    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);\r\n'
            '    if (!listEquals(oldWidget.markers, widget.markers) ||\r\n'
            '        oldWidget.provisionalPlaceCoordinate !=\r\n'
            '            widget.provisionalPlaceCoordinate) {\r\n'
            '      unawaited(_primeMarkerIcons());\r\n'
            '      _reconcileGroup();\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final coordinate = widget.initialCoordinate;\r\n'
            '    if (coordinate != null && oldWidget.initialCoordinate != coordinate) {\r\n'
            '      unawaited(_applyPassiveCoordinate(coordinate));\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final placementTarget = widget.placementTarget;\r\n'
            '    if (placementTarget != null &&\r\n'
            '        oldWidget.placementTarget != placementTarget) {\r\n'
            '      unawaited(_moveToPlacementTarget(placementTarget));\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (oldWidget.interactionPaused != widget.interactionPaused) {\r\n'
            '      unawaited(_syncInteractionPaused(widget.interactionPaused));\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  @override\r\n'
            '  void dispose() {\r\n'
            '    _interactionChannel?.setMethodCallHandler(null);\r\n'
            '    _controller?.dispose();\r\n'
            '    super.dispose();\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  List<MapMarker> get _visibleMarkerData {\r\n'
            '    final focusedKey = ref\r\n'
            '        .read(mapTransientFocusProvider)\r\n'
            '        .visibilityLease\r\n'
            '        ?.markerKey;\r\n'
            '    // Define Boundary editor exception (M6.2): while the same-map boundary\r\n'
            '    // editor is active, the working Saved Place marker stays visible even\r\n'
            '    // when the Saved Places layer preference is OFF — the editor must never\r\n'
            '    // be made impossible by layer visibility.\r\n'
            '    final boundaryEditorActive = widget.interactionPaused;\r\n'
            '    return widget.markers\r\n'
            '        .where(\r\n'
            '          (marker) =>\r\n'
            '              marker.ownerKey == focusedKey ||\r\n'
            '              (marker.owner == MapCoordinateOwner.contact && _showPeople) ||\r\n'
            '              (marker.owner == MapCoordinateOwner.event && _showEvents) ||\r\n'
            '              (marker.owner == MapCoordinateOwner.savedPlace &&\r\n'
            '                  (_showPlaces || boundaryEditorActive)),\r\n'
            '        )\r\n'
            '        .toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Set<Marker> get _markers {\r\n'
            '    final selection = ref.read(mapSelectedMarkerProvider);\r\n'
            '    final selectedKey = selection?.excludedOwnerKey;\r\n'
            '    final result = <Marker>{};\r\n'
            '    for (final target in _interactionTargets) {\r\n'
            '      final marker = target.members.first;\r\n'
            '      if (target.isAggregate) {\r\n'
            '        final count = target.members.length;\r\n'
            '        final selectedGroup =\r\n'
            '            selection?.isGroup == true &&\r\n'
            '            selection!.grouping == MapMarkerGrouping.exactCoordinate &&\r\n'
            '            target.coordinate == selection.origin?.position;\r\n'
            '        if (selectedGroup && !_selectedAggregateIcons.containsKey(count)) {\r\n'
            '          unawaited(_primeSelectedAggregateIcon(count));\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        final separateRemainder =\r\n'
            '            selectedKey != null &&\r\n'
            '            _visibleMarkerData.any(\r\n'
            '              (member) =>\r\n'
            '                  member.ownerKey == selectedKey &&\r\n'
            '                  member.coordinate == target.coordinate,\r\n'
            '            );\r\n'
            '        final remainderKey = \'$count:$selectedGroup\';\r\n'
            '        if (separateRemainder &&\r\n'
            '            !_separatedRemainderIcons.containsKey(remainderKey)) {\r\n'
            '          unawaited(_primeSeparatedRemainder(count, selectedGroup));\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        final icon =\r\n'
            '            (separateRemainder\r\n'
            '                ? _separatedRemainderIcons[remainderKey]\r\n'
            '                : null) ??\r\n'
            '            (selectedGroup ? _selectedAggregateIcons[count] : null) ??\r\n'
            '            _aggregateIcons[count];\r\n'
            '        if (!_aggregateIcons.containsKey(count)) {\r\n'
            '          unawaited(_primeAggregateIcon(count));\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        final cached = _normalMarkers[target.key];\r\n'
            '        result.add(\r\n'
            '          cached != null && cached.icon == icon\r\n'
            '              ? cached\r\n'
            '              : _normalMarkers[target.key] = Marker(\r\n'
            '                  markerId: MarkerId(target.key),\r\n'
            '                  position: LatLng(\r\n'
            '                    target.coordinate.latitude,\r\n'
            '                    target.coordinate.longitude,\r\n'
            '                  ),\r\n'
            '                  icon: icon ?? BitmapDescriptor.defaultMarker,\r\n'
            '                  consumeTapEvents: true,\r\n'
            '                  clusterManagerId: selectedGroup\r\n'
            '                      ? null\r\n'
            '                      : _clusterIdFor(marker.owner),\r\n'
            '                  zIndexInt: selectedGroup ? 20 : 0,\r\n'
            '                  onTap: () => _selectGroup(\r\n'
            '                    target.members,\r\n'
            '                    MapMarkerGrouping.exactCoordinate,\r\n'
            '                  ),\r\n'
            '                ),\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      } else {\r\n'
            '        result.add(_recordMarker(marker, false));\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (selectedKey != null) {\r\n'
            '      for (final marker in _visibleMarkerData) {\r\n'
            '        if (marker.ownerKey == selectedKey) {\r\n'
            '          final selected = _recordMarker(marker, selection?.isGroup == false);\r\n'
            '          // A selected remainder group keeps the former member outside it,\r\n'
            '          // without a second red pin or duplicated cluster membership.\r\n'
            '          result.add(\r\n'
            '            selection?.isGroup == true\r\n'
            '                ? Marker(\r\n'
            '                    markerId: selected.markerId,\r\n'
            '                    position: selected.position,\r\n'
            '                    icon: selected.icon,\r\n'
            '                    consumeTapEvents: true,\r\n'
            '                    infoWindow: selected.infoWindow,\r\n'
            '                    onTap: selected.onTap,\r\n'
            '                  )\r\n'
            '                : selected,\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '          break;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final provisional = widget.provisionalPlaceCoordinate;\r\n'
            '    if (provisional != null) {\r\n'
            '      final marker = _provisionalMarker(provisional);\r\n'
            '      result.add(\r\n'
            '        Marker(\r\n'
            '          markerId: const MarkerId(\'provisional-place\'),\r\n'
            '          position: LatLng(provisional.latitude, provisional.longitude),\r\n'
            '          icon:\r\n'
            '              _markerIcons[_markerIconKey(marker, false)] ??\r\n'
            '              BitmapDescriptor.defaultMarker,\r\n'
            '          zIndexInt: 30,\r\n'
            '          flat: false,\r\n'
            '        ),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return result;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Marker _recordMarker(MapMarker marker, bool selected) {\r\n'
            '    final normalIcon =\r\n'
            '        _markerIcons[_markerIconKey(marker, false)] ??\r\n'
            '        BitmapDescriptor.defaultMarker;\r\n'
            '    var normal = _normalMarkers[marker.ownerKey];\r\n'
            '    if (normal == null || normal.icon != normalIcon) {\r\n'
            '      normal = _normalMarkers[marker.ownerKey] = Marker(\r\n'
            '        markerId: MarkerId(marker.ownerKey),\r\n'
            '        position: LatLng(\r\n'
            '          marker.coordinate.latitude,\r\n'
            '          marker.coordinate.longitude,\r\n'
            '        ),\r\n'
            '        infoWindow: InfoWindow(title: marker.displayName),\r\n'
            '        consumeTapEvents: true,\r\n'
            '        flat: false,\r\n'
            '        icon: normalIcon,\r\n'
            '        clusterManagerId: _groupNearby ? _clusterIdFor(marker.owner) : null,\r\n'
            '        onTap: () => _selectMarker(marker),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!selected) return normal;\r\n'
            '    // Keep the accepted direct-selection anchor and native cluster exclusion.\r\n'
            '    return Marker(\r\n'
            '      markerId: normal.markerId,\r\n'
            '      position: normal.position,\r\n'
            '      infoWindow: normal.infoWindow,\r\n'
            '      consumeTapEvents: true,\r\n'
            '      flat: false,\r\n'
            '      icon: _markerIcons[_markerIconKey(marker, true)] ?? normalIcon,\r\n'
            '      zIndexInt: 20,\r\n'
            '      onTap: normal.onTap,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  ClusterManagerId _clusterIdFor(MapCoordinateOwner owner) => switch (owner) {\r\n'
            '    MapCoordinateOwner.contact => _peopleClusterId,\r\n'
            '    MapCoordinateOwner.event => _eventsClusterId,\r\n'
            '    MapCoordinateOwner.savedPlace => _placesClusterId,\r\n'
            '  };\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  MapMarker _provisionalMarker(MapCoordinate coordinate) => MapMarker(\r\n'
            '    owner: MapCoordinateOwner.savedPlace,\r\n'
            '    recordId: \'provisional\',\r\n'
            '    coordinate: coordinate,\r\n'
            '    displayName: \'New Place\',\r\n'
            '    colorValue: AppTheme.blueLightPrimary.toARGB32(),\r\n'
            '  );\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _onMapCreated(GoogleMapController controller) async {\r\n'
            '    _controller = controller;\r\n'
            '    widget.onMapController?.call(controller);\r\n'
            '    ref.read(mapsSessionProvider.notifier).recordCamera(_initialCameraPosition);\r\n'
            '    if (!kIsWeb && defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.android) {\r\n'
            '      _interactionChannel = MethodChannel(\r\n'
            '        \'nexttransfer/maps_interaction/${controller.mapId}\',\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      _interactionChannel!.setMethodCallHandler(_onNativeInteraction);\r\n'
            '      await _interactionChannel!.invokeMethod<void>(\'configure\', {\r\n'
            '        \'enabled\': !widget.interactionPaused,\r\n'
            '        \'trace\': MapInteractionTrace.enabled,\r\n'
            '      });\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted) return;\r\n'
            '      await _syncNativeSelection(\r\n'
            '        ref.read(mapSelectedMarkerProvider),\r\n'
            '        _selectionGeneration,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (widget.placementTarget case final placementTarget?) {\r\n'
            '      await _moveToPlacementTarget(placementTarget);\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final focus = ref.read(mapTransientFocusProvider).pending;\r\n'
            '    if (focus != null) {\r\n'
            '      await _handleFocus(focus);\r\n'
            '    } else if (widget.initialCoordinate case final coordinate?) {\r\n'
            '      await _applyPassiveCoordinate(coordinate);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _handleFocus(MapFocusRequest request) async {\r\n'
            '    if (_controller == null || _lastDispatchedFocusNonce == request.nonce) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _lastDispatchedFocusNonce = request.nonce;\r\n'
            '    _startupCameraClaimed = true;\r\n'
            '    final intent = ++_cameraIntent;\r\n'
            '    final animation = _animateTo(\r\n'
            '      request.coordinate,\r\n'
            '      zoom: 15,\r\n'
            '      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 650),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    // Consume after dispatch, not after an asynchronous completion: tab\r\n'
            '    // recreation must never replay a camera command already sent to Maps.\r\n'
            '    ref.read(mapTransientFocusProvider.notifier).consume(request.nonce);\r\n'
            '    await animation;\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted || intent != _cameraIntent) return;\r\n'
            '    if (request.ownerKind == MapFocusOwnerKind.savedPlace) {\r\n'
            '      for (final marker in widget.markers) {\r\n'
            '        if (marker.ownerKey == request.markerKey) {\r\n'
            '          ref.read(mapSelectedMarkerProvider.notifier).select(marker);\r\n'
            '          break;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static String _markerIconKey(MapMarker marker, bool selected) => <Object?>[\r\n'
            '    marker.owner.name,\r\n'
            '    marker.colorValue,\r\n'
            '    marker.isFavorite,\r\n'
            '    marker.placeMarkerMode,\r\n'
            '    marker.placeStandardCategory,\r\n'
            '    marker.placeEmoji,\r\n'
            '    selected,\r\n'
            '  ].join(\':\');\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _primeMarkerIcons() async {\r\n'
            '    unawaited(_primeSelectedIcon(ref.read(mapSelectedMarkerProvider)));\r\n'
            '    final unique = <String, MapMarker>{\r\n'
            '      for (final marker in widget.markers)\r\n'
            '        _markerIconKey(marker, false): marker,\r\n'
            '      if (widget.provisionalPlaceCoordinate case final point?)\r\n'
            '        _markerIconKey(_provisionalMarker(point), false): _provisionalMarker(\r\n'
            '          point,\r\n'
            '        ),\r\n'
            '    };\r\n'
            '    await Future.wait([\r\n'
            '      for (final marker in unique.values) _loadMarkerIcon(marker, false),\r\n'
            '    ]);\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted) return;\r\n'
            '    setState(() {});\r\n'
            '    // Warm each visual identity once, not once per record/occurrence. Direct\r\n'
            '    // taps can join an in-flight request without waiting for this queue.\r\n'
            '    for (final marker in unique.values) {\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted) return;\r\n'
            '      await _loadMarkerIcon(marker, true);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _primeSelectedIcon(MapSelectedMarker? selection) async {\r\n'
            '    if (selection == null || selection.isGroup) return;\r\n'
            '    final marker = selection.marker;\r\n'
            '    final gesture = MapInteractionTrace.token;\r\n'
            '    if (_markerIcons.containsKey(_markerIconKey(marker, true))) {\r\n'
            '      MapInteractionTrace.record(\r\n'
            '        \'T2\',\r\n'
            '        marker.ownerKey,\r\n'
            '        gesture: gesture,\r\n'
            '        extra: \'cache-hit\',\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    await _loadMarkerIcon(marker, true);\r\n'
            '    MapInteractionTrace.record(\r\n'
            '      \'T2\',\r\n'
            '      marker.ownerKey,\r\n'
            '      gesture: gesture,\r\n'
            '      extra: \'bitmap-ready\',\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    // Bitmaps never write selection. A stale completion only warms the cache.\r\n'
            '    if (mounted && identical(ref.read(mapSelectedMarkerProvider), selection)) {\r\n'
            '      setState(() {});\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static Future<BitmapDescriptor> _loadMarkerIcon(\r\n'
            '    MapMarker marker,\r\n'
            '    bool selected,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final key = _markerIconKey(marker, selected);\r\n'
            '    final cached = _markerIcons[key];\r\n'
            '    if (cached != null) return Future.value(cached);\r\n'
            '    return _loadingMarkerIcons.putIfAbsent(key, () async {\r\n'
            '      try {\r\n'
            '        final icon = await _buildMarkerIcon(marker, selected: selected);\r\n'
            '        _markerIcons[key] = icon;\r\n'
            '        return icon;\r\n'
            '      } finally {\r\n'
            '        unawaited(_loadingMarkerIcons.remove(key));\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _primeAggregateIcon(int count) async {\r\n'
            '    final icon = await _loadingAggregateIcons.putIfAbsent(count, () async {\r\n'
            '      const size = 96.0;\r\n'
            '      final recorder = ui.PictureRecorder();\r\n'
            '      final canvas = Canvas(recorder);\r\n'
            '      canvas.drawCircle(\r\n'
            '        const Offset(48, 48),\r\n'
            '        41,\r\n'
            '        Paint()..color = const Color(0xFF175A8F),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      canvas.drawCircle(\r\n'
            '        const Offset(48, 48),\r\n'
            '        41,\r\n'
            '        Paint()\r\n'
            '          ..color = Colors.white\r\n'
            '          ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke\r\n'
            '          ..strokeWidth = 2,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      _paintText(\r\n'
            '        canvas,\r\n'
            '        \'$count\',\r\n'
            '        const Offset(48, 48),\r\n'
            '        Offset(48, count < 100 ? 40 : 28),\r\n'
            '        color: Colors.white,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      final picture = recorder.endRecording();\r\n'
            '      final image = await picture.toImage(size.toInt(), size.toInt());\r\n'
            '      picture.dispose();\r\n'
            '      final bytes = await image.toByteData(format: ui.ImageByteFormat.png);\r\n'
            '      image.dispose();\r\n'
            '      return bytes == null\r\n'
            '          ? BitmapDescriptor.defaultMarker\r\n'
            '          : BitmapDescriptor.bytes(\r\n'
            '              bytes.buffer.asUint8List(),\r\n'
            '              width: _markerLogicalSize,\r\n'
            '              height: _markerLogicalSize,\r\n'
            '            );\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '    _aggregateIcons[count] = icon;\r\n'
            '    if (mounted) setState(() {});\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _onNativeInteraction(MethodCall call) async {\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted || call.method != \'tap\') return;\r\n'
            '    final data = Map<Object?, Object?>.from(call.arguments as Map);\r\n'
            '    final token = (data[\'token\'] as num).toInt();\r\n'
            '    if (token <= _lastNativeToken) return;\r\n'
            '    _lastNativeToken = token;\r\n'
            '    MapInteractionTrace.nativeTap(\r\n'
            '      _controller!.mapId,\r\n'
            '      token,\r\n'
            '      (data[\'renderGeneration\'] as num).toInt(),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final targets = {\r\n'
            '      for (final target in _interactionTargets) target.key: target,\r\n'
            '    };\r\n'
            '    final recordId = data[\'recordId\'] as String?;\r\n'
            '    if (recordId != null) {\r\n'
            '      final target = targets[recordId];\r\n'
            '      if (target != null) {\r\n'
            '        _selectGroup(target.members, MapMarkerGrouping.exactCoordinate);\r\n'
            '      } else {\r\n'
            '        // The selected individual is intentionally outside the target set.\r\n'
            '        for (final marker in _visibleMarkerData) {\r\n'
            '          if (marker.ownerKey == recordId) {\r\n'
            '            _selectMarker(marker);\r\n'
            '            break;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final ids = (data[\'ids\'] as List?)?.cast<String>() ?? const <String>[];\r\n'
            '    if (ids.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      if (widget.onMapTap != null) {\r\n'
            '        widget.onMapTap!();\r\n'
            '      } else {\r\n'
            '        ref.read(mapSelectedMarkerProvider.notifier).clear();\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // Reject stale native membership rather than reopening an older group.\r\n'
            '    if (ids.any((id) => !targets.containsKey(id))) return;\r\n'
            '    final members = [for (final id in ids) ...targets[id]!.members];\r\n'
            '    _selectGroup(\r\n'
            '      members,\r\n'
            '      MapMarkerGrouping.zoomCluster,\r\n'
            '      origin: MapMarkerGroupContext(\r\n'
            '        members: members,\r\n'
            '        position: MapCoordinate(\r\n'
            '          latitude: (data[\'latitude\'] as num).toDouble(),\r\n'
            '          longitude: (data[\'longitude\'] as num).toDouble(),\r\n'
            '        ),\r\n'
            '        nativeMarkerIds: ids,\r\n'
            '        nativeGroupKey: data[\'groupKey\'] as String?,\r\n'
            '        bitmap: data[\'bitmap\'] as Uint8List?,\r\n'
            '        width: (data[\'width\'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 34,\r\n'
            '        height: (data[\'height\'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 34,\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _syncNativeSelection(\r\n'
            '    MapSelectedMarker? selection,\r\n'
            '    int generation,\r\n'
            '  ) async {\r\n'
            '    final channel = _interactionChannel;\r\n'
            '    if (channel == null) return;\r\n'
            '    final origin = selection?.origin;\r\n'
            '    final exclusion = selection?.excludedOwnerKey;\r\n'
            '    final liveTargets = _interactionTargets.map((target) => target.key).toSet();\r\n'
            '    final remainderIds = exclusion == null\r\n'
            '        ? <String>[]\r\n'
            '        : [\r\n'
            '            for (final id in origin?.nativeMarkerIds ?? const <String>[])\r\n'
            '              if (id != exclusion && liveTargets.contains(id)) id,\r\n'
            '          ];\r\n'
            '    final groupKey = selection?.isGroup == true ? origin?.nativeGroupKey : null;\r\n'
            '    final args = <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '      \'generation\': generation,\r\n'
            '      \'selectedOwnerId\': exclusion,\r\n'
            '      \'selectedManagerId\': selection == null\r\n'
            '          ? null\r\n'
            '          : _clusterIdFor(selection.marker.owner).value,\r\n'
            '      \'inferRemainder\':\r\n'
            '          selection != null && !selection.isGroup && origin == null,\r\n'
            '      \'remainderIds\': remainderIds,\r\n'
            '      \'groupKey\': groupKey,\r\n'
            '    };\r\n'
            '    await channel.invokeMethod<void>(\'selection\', args);\r\n'
            '    if (groupKey == null || origin?.bitmap == null) return;\r\n'
            '    final gesture = MapInteractionTrace.token;\r\n'
            '    final bitmap =\r\n'
            '        await _composeSelectedGroup(\r\n'
            '              origin!.bitmap!,\r\n'
            '              width: origin.width,\r\n'
            '              height: origin.height,\r\n'
            '            )\r\n'
            '            as BytesMapBitmap;\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted ||\r\n'
            '        generation != _selectionGeneration ||\r\n'
            '        !identical(ref.read(mapSelectedMarkerProvider), selection)) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    MapInteractionTrace.record(\r\n'
            '      \'T2\',\r\n'
            '      groupKey,\r\n'
            '      gesture: gesture,\r\n'
            '      extra: \'group-pin-ready\',\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    await channel.invokeMethod<void>(\'selection\', {\r\n'
            '      ...args,\r\n'
            '      \'groupPin\': bitmap.byteData,\r\n'
            '      \'width\': bitmap.width,\r\n'
            '      \'height\': bitmap.height,\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _primeSeparatedRemainder(int count, bool selected) async {\r\n'
            '    final key = \'$count:$selected\';\r\n'
            '    if (!_loadingSeparatedRemainders.add(key)) return;\r\n'
            '    try {\r\n'
            '      if (!_aggregateIcons.containsKey(count)) await _primeAggregateIcon(count);\r\n'
            '      if (selected && !_selectedAggregateIcons.containsKey(count)) {\r\n'
            '        await _primeSelectedAggregateIcon(count);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final base = selected\r\n'
            '          ? _selectedAggregateIcons[count]\r\n'
            '          : _aggregateIcons[count];\r\n'
            '      if (base is! BytesMapBitmap) return;\r\n'
            '      final codec = await ui.instantiateImageCodec(base.byteData);\r\n'
            '      final input = (await codec.getNextFrame()).image;\r\n'
            '      final recorder = ui.PictureRecorder();\r\n'
            '      Canvas(recorder).drawImage(input, Offset.zero, Paint());\r\n'
            '      final picture = recorder.endRecording();\r\n'
            '      final image = await picture.toImage(input.width * 3, input.height);\r\n'
            '      final bytes = await image.toByteData(format: ui.ImageByteFormat.png);\r\n'
            '      _separatedRemainderIcons[key] = BitmapDescriptor.bytes(\r\n'
            '        bytes!.buffer.asUint8List(),\r\n'
            '        width: _markerLogicalSize * 3,\r\n'
            '        height: base.height,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      // The anchor and LatLng are unchanged. Only this remainder\'s painted\r\n'
            '      // count sits 34 logical px left of the shared anchor, clear of the\r\n'
            '      // individual. Native alpha picking rejects the transparent canvas.\r\n'
            '      input.dispose();\r\n'
            '      image.dispose();\r\n'
            '      picture.dispose();\r\n'
            '      codec.dispose();\r\n'
            '      if (mounted) setState(() {});\r\n'
            '    } finally {\r\n'
            '      _loadingSeparatedRemainders.remove(key);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _primeSelectedAggregateIcon(int count) async {\r\n'
            '    if (!_loadingSelectedAggregates.add(count)) return;\r\n'
            '    try {\r\n'
            '      if (!_aggregateIcons.containsKey(count)) await _primeAggregateIcon(count);\r\n'
            '      final base = _aggregateIcons[count];\r\n'
            '      if (base is! BytesMapBitmap) return;\r\n'
            '      _selectedAggregateIcons[count] = await _composeSelectedGroup(\r\n'
            '        base.byteData,\r\n'
            '        width: 34,\r\n'
            '        height: 34,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (mounted) setState(() {});\r\n'
            '    } finally {\r\n'
            '      _loadingSelectedAggregates.remove(count);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Reuse the frozen pin painter at its accepted logical scale. The native\r\n'
            '  /// count bitmap keeps its original pixels/size and bottom-center anchor.\r\n'
            '  static Future<BitmapDescriptor> _composeSelectedGroup(\r\n'
            '    Uint8List bytes, {\r\n'
            '    required double width,\r\n'
            '    required double height,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    final codec = await ui.instantiateImageCodec(bytes);\r\n'
            '    final base = (await codec.getNextFrame()).image;\r\n'
            '    final ratio = base.width / width;\r\n'
            '    final extension = _selectedPinCanvasExtension * _markerLogicalSize / 96;\r\n'
            '    final outputHeight = height + extension;\r\n'
            '    final recorder = ui.PictureRecorder();\r\n'
            '    final canvas = Canvas(recorder);\r\n'
            '    canvas.drawImage(base, Offset(0, extension * ratio), Paint());\r\n'
            '    final scale = ratio * _markerLogicalSize / 96;\r\n'
            '    canvas.save();\r\n'
            '    canvas.scale(scale);\r\n'
            '    final identityCenter = Offset(\r\n'
            '      base.width / scale / 2,\r\n'
            '      (extension * ratio + base.height / 2) / scale,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    _paintSelectedLocationPinGlyph(\r\n'
            '      canvas,\r\n'
            '      Offset(\r\n'
            '        identityCenter.dx,\r\n'
            '        identityCenter.dy -\r\n'
            '            _selectedIdentityRadius -\r\n'
            '            _selectedPinGlyphSize / 2 +\r\n'
            '            32,\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    canvas.restore();\r\n'
            '    final picture = recorder.endRecording();\r\n'
            '    final image = await picture.toImage(\r\n'
            '      base.width,\r\n'
            '      (outputHeight * ratio).ceil(),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final data = await image.toByteData(format: ui.ImageByteFormat.png);\r\n'
            '    picture.dispose();\r\n'
            '    image.dispose();\r\n'
            '    base.dispose();\r\n'
            '    codec.dispose();\r\n'
            '    return BitmapDescriptor.bytes(\r\n'
            '      data!.buffer.asUint8List(),\r\n'
            '      width: width,\r\n'
            '      height: outputHeight,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static Future<BitmapDescriptor> _buildMarkerIcon(\r\n'
            '    MapMarker marker, {\r\n'
            '    required bool selected,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    const size = 96.0;\r\n'
            '    // Selection extends the bitmap UPWARD only. The identity keeps its exact\r\n'
            '    // unselected canvas position (48 bitmap pixels above the bottom map\r\n'
            '    // anchor), so the base record never moves to another geographic position\r\n'
            '    // when selection changes and the red pin can sit directly above it.\r\n'
            '    final canvasHeight = selected ? size + _selectedPinCanvasExtension : size;\r\n'
            '    final recorder = ui.PictureRecorder();\r\n'
            '    final canvas = Canvas(recorder);\r\n'
            '    final identityCenter = Offset(size / 2, canvasHeight - size / 2);\r\n'
            '    final color = Color(marker.colorValue);\r\n'
            '    final fill = Paint()\r\n'
            '      ..color = color\r\n'
            '      ..style = PaintingStyle.fill;\r\n'
            '    final outline = Paint()\r\n'
            '      ..color = Colors.white\r\n'
            '      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke\r\n'
            '      ..strokeWidth = _markerEdgeWidth;\r\n'
            '    if (marker.owner == MapCoordinateOwner.contact && marker.isFavorite) {\r\n'
            '      final star = _starPath(identityCenter, 38, 16);\r\n'
            '      canvas.drawPath(\r\n'
            '        star.shift(const Offset(0, 3)),\r\n'
            '        Paint()\r\n'
            '          ..color = Colors.black.withValues(alpha: .24)\r\n'
            '          ..maskFilter = const MaskFilter.blur(BlurStyle.normal, 3),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      canvas.drawPath(star, fill);\r\n'
            '      canvas.drawPath(star, outline);\r\n'
            '    } else if (marker.owner == MapCoordinateOwner.contact) {\r\n'
            '      canvas.drawCircle(identityCenter, 35, fill);\r\n'
            '      canvas.drawCircle(identityCenter, 35, outline);\r\n'
            '    } else if (marker.owner == MapCoordinateOwner.event) {\r\n'
            '      final eventRect = RRect.fromRectAndRadius(\r\n'
            '        Rect.fromCenter(center: identityCenter, width: 66, height: 66),\r\n'
            '        const Radius.circular(14),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      canvas.drawRRect(eventRect, fill);\r\n'
            '      canvas.drawRRect(eventRect, outline);\r\n'
            '      canvas.drawLine(\r\n'
            '        Offset(identityCenter.dx - 18, identityCenter.dy - 10),\r\n'
            '        Offset(identityCenter.dx + 18, identityCenter.dy - 10),\r\n'
            '        Paint()\r\n'
            '          ..color = Colors.white\r\n'
            '          ..strokeWidth = 5\r\n'
            '          ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      final calendarInk = Paint()..color = Colors.white;\r\n'
            '      for (final x in <double>[-11, 11]) {\r\n'
            '        canvas.drawLine(\r\n'
            '          Offset(identityCenter.dx + x, identityCenter.dy - 27),\r\n'
            '          Offset(identityCenter.dx + x, identityCenter.dy - 18),\r\n'
            '          Paint()\r\n'
            '            ..color = Colors.white\r\n'
            '            ..strokeWidth = 5\r\n'
            '            ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      for (final point in <Offset>[\r\n'
            '        Offset(identityCenter.dx - 11, identityCenter.dy + 3),\r\n'
            '        Offset(identityCenter.dx + 11, identityCenter.dy + 3),\r\n'
            '        Offset(identityCenter.dx - 11, identityCenter.dy + 17),\r\n'
            '        Offset(identityCenter.dx + 11, identityCenter.dy + 17),\r\n'
            '      ]) {\r\n'
            '        canvas.drawCircle(point, 4, calendarInk);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    } else {\r\n'
            '      _paintPlaceIdentity(canvas, marker, identityCenter);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (selected) {\r\n'
            '      // Tighten only the bitmap composition. The base center and the Google\r\n'
            '      // bottom-center anchor stay unchanged. Paint the semantic red pin last\r\n'
            '      // so only its tip meets the identity; no record color enters its head.\r\n'
            '      final identityTop = identityCenter.dy - _selectedIdentityRadius;\r\n'
            '      _paintSelectedLocationPinGlyph(\r\n'
            '        canvas,\r\n'
            '        Offset(size / 2, identityTop - _selectedPinGlyphSize / 2 + 32),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final picture = recorder.endRecording();\r\n'
            '    final image = await picture.toImage(size.toInt(), canvasHeight.toInt());\r\n'
            '    picture.dispose();\r\n'
            '    final data = await image.toByteData(format: ui.ImageByteFormat.png);\r\n'
            '    image.dispose();\r\n'
            '    if (data == null) return BitmapDescriptor.defaultMarker;\r\n'
            '    return BitmapDescriptor.bytes(\r\n'
            '      data.buffer.asUint8List(),\r\n'
            '      width: _markerLogicalSize,\r\n'
            '      height: _markerLogicalSize * canvasHeight / size,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Draws the Saved Place identity as an upright, screen-facing square in the\r\n'
            '  /// persisted color; from the marker\'s mode it renders either the category\r\n'
            '  /// glyph concept or the custom emoji inside the white center disc. A thin\r\n'
            '  /// white edge preserves separation without replacing the identity.\r\n'
            '  static void _paintPlaceIdentity(\r\n'
            '    Canvas canvas,\r\n'
            '    MapMarker marker,\r\n'
            '    Offset identityCenter,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final identity = SavedPlaceVisualIdentity.resolve(\r\n'
            '      mode: marker.placeMarkerMode ?? SavedPlaceMarkerMode.standard,\r\n'
            '      category:\r\n'
            '          marker.placeStandardCategory ??\r\n'
            '          SavedPlaceStandardCategory.information,\r\n'
            '      color: Color(marker.colorValue),\r\n'
            '      emoji: marker.placeEmoji?.trim(),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final emoji = identity.emoji;\r\n'
            '    if (emoji != null && emoji.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      _paintText(canvas, emoji, identityCenter, const Offset(64, 64));\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final color = identity.color;\r\n'
            '    final fill = Paint()\r\n'
            '      ..color = color\r\n'
            '      ..style = PaintingStyle.fill;\r\n'
            '    final outline = Paint()\r\n'
            '      ..color = Colors.white\r\n'
            '      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke\r\n'
            '      ..strokeWidth = _markerEdgeWidth;\r\n'
            '    final square = RRect.fromRectAndRadius(\r\n'
            '      Rect.fromCenter(center: identityCenter, width: 66, height: 66),\r\n'
            '      const Radius.circular(10),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    canvas.drawRRect(square, fill);\r\n'
            '    canvas.drawRRect(square, outline);\r\n'
            '    {\r\n'
            '      final icon = identity.icon!;\r\n'
            '      _paintText(\r\n'
            '        canvas,\r\n'
            '        String.fromCharCode(icon.codePoint),\r\n'
            '        identityCenter,\r\n'
            '        const Offset(46, 46),\r\n'
            '        color: identity.foreground,\r\n'
            '        isMaterialIcon: true,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static void _paintText(\r\n'
            '    Canvas canvas,\r\n'
            '    String text,\r\n'
            '    Offset center,\r\n'
            '    Offset logicalSize, {\r\n'
            '    Color? color,\r\n'
            '    bool isMaterialIcon = false,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final painter = TextPainter(\r\n'
            '      text: TextSpan(\r\n'
            '        text: text,\r\n'
            '        style: TextStyle(\r\n'
            '          fontSize: logicalSize.dy,\r\n'
            '          fontFamily: isMaterialIcon ? \'MaterialIcons\' : null,\r\n'
            '          color: color,\r\n'
            '          height: 1.0,\r\n'
            '        ),\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,\r\n'
            '      textAlign: TextAlign.center,\r\n'
            '    )..layout();\r\n'
            '    painter.paint(\r\n'
            '      canvas,\r\n'
            '      center - Offset(painter.width / 2, painter.height / 2),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Paints Flutter\'s real location-pin glyph with a restrained white\r\n'
            '  /// separation edge and the pin\'s own darker-red head detail. The head is\r\n'
            '  /// semantic red only — it must never inherit the app theme accent, and no\r\n'
            '  /// blue/teal dot is drawn inside it. The manually approximated Pass 1\r\n'
            '  /// Bézier pin was malformed on the physical device and is removed.\r\n'
            '  static void _paintSelectedLocationPinGlyph(Canvas canvas, Offset center) {\r\n'
            '    _paintMaterialIconGlyph(\r\n'
            '      canvas,\r\n'
            '      Icons.location_pin,\r\n'
            '      center,\r\n'
            '      size: _selectedPinGlyphSize,\r\n'
            '      color: Colors.white,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    _paintMaterialIconGlyph(\r\n'
            '      canvas,\r\n'
            '      Icons.location_pin,\r\n'
            '      center,\r\n'
            '      size: _selectedPinGlyphSize - 4,\r\n'
            '      color: Colors.red.shade700,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    // The pin\'s own darker-red head detail (PMG reference). This is a fixed\r\n'
            '    // semantic red, deliberately independent of the active theme accent.\r\n'
            '    canvas.drawCircle(\r\n'
            '      Offset(center.dx, center.dy - _selectedPinGlyphSize * 0.14),\r\n'
            '      _selectedPinGlyphSize * 0.11,\r\n'
            '      Paint()..color = Colors.red.shade900,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static void _paintMaterialIconGlyph(\r\n'
            '    Canvas canvas,\r\n'
            '    IconData icon,\r\n'
            '    Offset center, {\r\n'
            '    required double size,\r\n'
            '    required Color color,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final painter = TextPainter(\r\n'
            '      text: TextSpan(\r\n'
            '        text: String.fromCharCode(icon.codePoint),\r\n'
            '        style: TextStyle(\r\n'
            '          color: color,\r\n'
            '          fontSize: size,\r\n'
            '          fontFamily: icon.fontFamily,\r\n'
            '          package: icon.fontPackage,\r\n'
            '          height: 1,\r\n'
            '        ),\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,\r\n'
            '    )..layout();\r\n'
            '    painter.paint(\r\n'
            '      canvas,\r\n'
            '      center - Offset(painter.width / 2, painter.height / 2),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static Path _starPath(Offset center, double outerRadius, double innerRadius) {\r\n'
            '    final path = Path();\r\n'
            '    for (var index = 0; index < 10; index += 1) {\r\n'
            '      final radius = index.isEven ? outerRadius : innerRadius;\r\n'
            '      final angle = -math.pi / 2 + (math.pi * index / 5);\r\n'
            '      final point = Offset(\r\n'
            '        center.dx + math.cos(angle) * radius,\r\n'
            '        center.dy + math.sin(angle) * radius,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (index == 0) {\r\n'
            '        path.moveTo(point.dx, point.dy);\r\n'
            '      } else {\r\n'
            '        path.lineTo(point.dx, point.dy);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return path..close();\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _animateTo(\r\n'
            '    MapCoordinate coordinate, {\r\n'
            '    required double zoom,\r\n'
            '    Duration? duration,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    await _controller?.animateCamera(\r\n'
            '      CameraUpdate.newLatLngZoom(\r\n'
            '        LatLng(coordinate.latitude, coordinate.longitude),\r\n'
            '        zoom,\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '      duration: duration,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _moveToPlacementTarget(MapCoordinate coordinate) async {\r\n'
            '    _startupCameraClaimed = true;\r\n'
            '    await _controller?.moveCamera(\r\n'
            '      CameraUpdate.newLatLng(LatLng(coordinate.latitude, coordinate.longitude)),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Same-map Define Boundary enter/exit. The native patch code is\r\n'
            '  /// untouched; only its existing enable/disable command is driven, and the\r\n'
            '  /// stored selection context is restored when the pause window ends.\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _syncInteractionPaused(bool paused) async {\r\n'
            '    final channel = _interactionChannel;\r\n'
            '    if (channel == null) return;\r\n'
            '    await channel.invokeMethod<void>(\'configure\', {\r\n'
            '      \'enabled\': !paused,\r\n'
            '      \'trace\': MapInteractionTrace.enabled,\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '    if (!paused) {\r\n'
            '      await _syncNativeSelection(\r\n'
            '        ref.read(mapSelectedMarkerProvider),\r\n'
            '        _selectionGeneration,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _locate() async {\r\n'
            '    if (_locating) return;\r\n'
            '    _startupCameraClaimed = true;\r\n'
            '    _cameraIntent += 1;\r\n'
            '    setState(() => _locating = true);\r\n'
            '    final result = await ref.read(currentLocationServiceProvider).locate();\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted) return;\r\n'
            '    setState(() {\r\n'
            '      _locating = false;\r\n'
            '      if (result.status == CurrentLocationStatus.located) {\r\n'
            '        _showMyLocation = true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '    final coordinate = result.coordinate;\r\n'
            '    if (coordinate != null) {\r\n'
